sentinel_collision_bug.what: advance()'s event discriminator used which==2 as the CONTACT-event sentinel while drive joint-stop events used which = the drive index 0..7 -- and drive 2 IS ankle_dorsiflexion_left. The first time the walk ever reached the left ankle's joint wall (tick 117, unreachable before the entry fix), the drive event set (which=2, khit=-1), the contact branch mistook it for a contact event, and probe[(size_t)-1]=0 wrote out of bounds, smearing the heap; the downstream frames.at() then read a garbage index (-104) and the uncaught std::out_of_range terminated the suite (the 'vector out of range' popup in Debug builds).
sentinel_collision_bug.diagnosis: line-traced gap_of under GAIT_EVENT_TRACE printed k=(size_t)-1 with the walker state INTACT (frames=10, bodies=10) -- an index bug, not corruption; ablation had already exonerated the positional correction
sentinel_collision_bug.fix: distinct namespaces: which = 0..7 drive events, which = -2 contact events (khit = the point), which = -1 none; the fp-level clamp branch now pins ANY drive's wall (the old which<2 only pinned drives 0/1 -- a second latent bug in the same branch); require(gait_event_namespace) guards the drive branch
sentinel_collision_bug.falsifier: the crash reproduced at tick 117/118 in every prior run and is gone in every run after the fix -- the walk proceeds one tick further to its next (clean) refusal

single_support_entry.law: the source model's 'enter at the TD state' is over-determined: TD-left means mid-stance-right (double support) and the tables' closure residual leaves the two stance contacts 2.96 mm apart; require(gap>0) forces the loaded leg 3 mm into the air and its drop delivers the ~1 J transient. The lawful entry is the SINGLE-SUPPORT instant: the phase where the composed stance thigh is VERTICAL (mid-stance by definition) and the swing foot is airborne -- derived by scan (phi=0.449, thigh tilt -0.08 deg), seated on the stance MP head (right heel 4.55 mm clear), entry speed from the no-skid law at that phase (0.849 m/s).
single_support_entry.measured: the walk runs past tick 110 continuously (was: dead at 40); no entry drop transient

positional_correction.law: when an impact state carries a penetrating point (geometric infeasibility), q is corrected along the mass-metric least-norm direction zeroing the penetrating gaps; the potential change is booked as the penetration's stored compression returned (s.impact -= du; the round trip returns what the discretization let through -- the ledger closes by construction); correction magnitude capped at 0.05 with a loud refusal
positional_correction.measured: fires continuously in the sub-uJ range during stance (2000-3000 events per walk), no free-energy anomaly, F-G5/F-G7 unaffected
